## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Enter '....'
4. See error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened.

## Screenshots / logs

If applicable, add screenshots, browser console errors, or relevant snippets from `dev.log` / `server.log`. **Redact any API keys** before pasting.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. macOS 14.2, Ubuntu 22.04, Windows 11]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 124, Firefox 125, Safari 17]
- Node / Bun version: [run `node -v` or `bun -v`]
- App version / commit: [run `git rev-parse --short HEAD`]
- Provider mode: [free / hybrid / own-keys / local]
- Provider(s) configured: [e.g. Groq, OpenRouter — **do not paste keys**]

## Project context (for generation-related bugs)

- Document type: [PRD / BRD / FRD / SOW / TECH_DESIGN / AUDIT / ROADMAP / GAP_ANALYSIS / AUTO]
- Source type: [repo / text / mixed]
- Source URL or summary: [e.g. https://github.com/vercel/next.js — or "internal notes about a habit tracker"]
- Stage where it failed: [e.g. `debate_round2`, `generate`, `evaluation`]
- Version ID (if available): [from the URL after a generation completes]

## Additional context

Add any other context about the problem here. Link to related issues or PRs if any.
